final: SELECT insurstat, AVG(site_ratio) AS avg_kept_ratio, COUNT(*) AS kept_site_count, AVG(site_ratio - status_avg) AS avg_excess FROM (SELECT insurstat, site_ratio, AVG(site_ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY insurstat) AS status_avg FROM (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, AVG(1.0 * m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS site_ratio, COUNT(m.facetregistry) AS mesh_record_count FROM sites AS s JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat) AS site_ratios WHERE site_ratio IS NOT NULL) AS compared_sites WHERE site_ratio > status_avg GROUP BY insurstat
